 Hon'Ble Sri Justice C.V. Bhaskar Reddy
 Writ Petition No.31858 of 2023
Order:

entities.text: Kotagiri Srinivas Rao vs State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
This writ petition is filed seeking the following relief:-
"...to issue any order or direction writ or writs more particularly on in the nature of writ of mandamus declaring the action of respondent Nos. 2 and 3 for not considering the representation given by petitioner on 09.11.2023 for directing the respondent No.4 not to harass the petitioner upon calling him regularly to the police station without filling the charge sheet in F.I.R.No. 280 of 2023 against petitioner is illegal, arbitrary and unconstitutional..."
2. The case of the petitioner is that he is accused No.1 in Crime No.280 of 2022, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 465, 467, 468 and 471 read with 34 of I.P.C.

It is the further case of the petitioner that he filed Crl.M.P.No.1014 of 2023 on the file of the Additional Metropolitan Magistrate, Hyderabad and the said Court disposed of the said petition directing the respondents-police to follow the procedure as contemplated CVBR, J Wp_31858_2023 under Section 41-A of Cr.P.C. and also the guidelines issued by the Hon'ble Apex Court in Arnesh Kumar Vs. State of Bihar 1.

entities.text: Arnesh Kumar Vs. State of Bihar 1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is the further case of the petitioner that he is suffering with serious liver disease and his health condition is not good and after receipt of the notice issued by the respondents-police he has appeared before the Assistant Commissioner of Police from 04.05.2023 till October, 2023 and the Assistant Commissioner of Police has recorded his statement and completed the petition.
It is the further case of the petitioner that even after completing the investigation on one pretext or the other, he was summoned to the police station and confined him for hours together.

It is further case of the petitioner that in view of his health condition, he has to visit the hospital frequently, but the police have insisted to come to the police station frequently and confined him in the police station, therefore, there is every possibility to endanger to his life if timely medication is not provided to him.

Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home appearing for the respondents has submitted that a case in Crime No.280 of 2022 was registered against the petitioner and as and when the presence of the petitioner is required, the respondents-police are summoned him to the police station for his appearance.
It is further submitted by the learned Assistant Government Pleader that the respondents-police are not harassing the petitioner in any manner.

4. In view of the said submissions, this Court deems it appropriate to dispose of the writ petition, if the presence of the petitioner is required for the purpose of investigation in Crime No.280 of 2022,
the respondents-police are directed to issue a notice in advance by specifying the date and time to Kotagiri Srinivas Rao vs State Of Telangana on 17 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/6931755/
1 enable the petitioner to be present for cooperating and concluding the investigation.

sentences.text: 5. With the above observations, the Writ Petition is disposed of.
There shall be no order as to costs.
As a sequel, the miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, shall stand closed.
